items.h: Makes two field goals in win
items.s: Lutz went two-for-two on both his field-goal attempts and extra-point tries during Denver's win over Carolina on Sunday. Lutz's field-goal tries were good from 26 and 48 yards. The 32-year-old has now converted 16 of his 19 field-goal attempts and all 16 of his extra-point tries across nine appearances this season.

items.h: Wil Lutz makes two field goals in Week 9
items.s: Wil Lutz converted field goals from 26 and 48 yards in the Broncos' 26-21 win over the Panthers in Week 9. Lutz has now made seven field goals over Denver's last three games. The Broncos scored 26 points Sunday, giving Lutz another productive afternoon. Denver enters its Week 10 bye before hosting the Raiders in Week 11.

items.h: Wil Lutz Is a Week 9 Streaming Option
items.s: Denver Broncos kicker Wil Lutz has converted nine of his last 10 field-goal attempts. He hit from 39 and 45 yards against Kansas City in Week 8 and made all three of his tries at Arizona the week before. He also went five-for-five on extra points across those two games, as the Broncos scored 28 and 30 points. Lutz is a reasonable streamer for Sunday's trip to Carolina, where the Panthers are allowing 27.6 points per game. RotoBaller ranks him K12 for Week 9. Opponents have attempted only 11 field goals against Carolina in seven games, converting 10. items.h: Makes all four kicks in Week 8 win
items.s: Lutz made both field-goal attempts and both PATs in Sunday's 28-24 win over the Chiefs. Lutz's field-goal tries were good from 39 and 45 yards in the first half. Kicking in Denver's anemic offense through eight games, the veteran has made just 14 of 17 FGAs and all 14 PATs. He's not an exciting fantasy kicker despite playing his home games in the most kicker-friendly environment.

items.h: Wil Lutz makes two field goals in Week 8
items.s: Wil Lutz made both of his field-goal attempts and both extra-point attempts in the Broncos' 28-24 win over the Chiefs in Week 8. Lutz connected from 39 and 45 yards. He has now made five field goals over the last two games as Denver's offense has scored 58 points. The scoring opportunities are there for Lutz.

items.h: Wil Lutz Perfect in Week 7 Win
items.s: Wil Lutz made all three of his field-goal attempts and all three extra-point attempts in the Broncos' 30-16 win over the Cardinals in Week 7. Lutz connected from 48, 43 and 31 yards, giving him 12 points on the afternoon. Denver's offense moved the ball much better than it had through the first six weeks, creating six scoring opportunities for Lutz. He is a viable weekly fantasy kicker.

items.h: Makes three field goals in win
items.s: Lutz went 3-for-3 on field-goal tries and made all three of his PATs during Sunday's 30-16 win over Arizona. Lutz was able to make multiple field goals for the third time in the last four contests. The kicker converted attempts from 48 and 43 yards in the first quarter before later adding a 31-yarder in the fourth quarter. Lutz has now gone 12-for-15 on field-goal attempts while making all 12 of his extra-point tries over the first seven games of the 2026 campaign.

items.h: Wil Lutz has five kicking points in win
items.s: Wil Lutz hit his only field goal and both of his PATs in the Broncos' 17-14 win over Seattle on Thursday. Lutz sealed the win for the Broncos in overtime with his kick, not seeing the field much more than that since the offense struggled to move the ball for the majority of the game. It wasn't a great night for the Broncos' offense, but better days will come for them and for Lutz to put up points.

Lutz made his lone field goal and both of his extra-point tries during the Broncos' 17-14 overtime win over the Seahawks on Thursday. It was a relatively quiet night for Lutz, who had just two kick attempts (both PATs) in the first half. However, he answered the call in overtime with a 53-yard field goal to seal the win for the Broncos. It was his second make of 50-plus yards this season, and through six games, Lutz has gone 9-for-12 on field-goal attempts and 9-for-9 on extra-point tries. The Broncos will hit the road for Week 7 against the Cardinals on Sunday, Oct. 25.

items.h: Misses field goal in Week 5 win
items.s: Lutz went 3-for-4 on field-goal attempts and connected on both of his extra-point tries during the Broncos' 23-17 win over the Chargers on Sunday. Lutz extended Denver's lead to 10-3 with a 34-yard field goal in the second quarter before making two more field goals in the fourth, though he also missed a 42-yarder earlier in the period that would have given the Broncos a 10-point cushion. Lutz has missed a field goal in each of the Broncos' last three games, with two of those misses coming from within 50 yards. The Broncos will operate on a short week, as their next game is a Week 6 home tilt against the Seahawks on Thursday Night Football.
